filename: PythonicDISORT_ A Python reimplementation of the Discrete Ordinate Radiative Transfer package DISORT.pdf
title: PythonicDISORT: A Python reimplementation of the Discrete Ordinate Radiative Transfer package DISORT
testbed_rationale: This paper introduces an open-source Python reimplementation of the 1D discrete ordinate radiative transfer solver (DISORT) and does not provide an ML parameterization dataset or benchmark.
pain_points: Computational speed trade-off: PythonicDISORT is slower than FORTRAN DISORT
Lacks latest advanced features of DISORT such as pseudo-spherical correction
extraction_notes: The paper describes scientific software funded by LEAP STC; no machine learning models were developed or evaluated.
